description.value: Barbara is a small, intimate reservation-only restaurant on East Pender Street in Vancouver, serving a creative tasting menu in a space limited to parties of four. The kitchen highlights Pacific Northwest ingredients — spot prawns, arctic char, duck hearts, seasonal vegetables — in a multi-course format. Walk-ins are welcomed at two standing tables for cocktails or wine, and the restaurant offers an inventive zero-proof drinks programme alongside its full bar.
